(1) Lachesis (arXiv:2610.08378), now full-text grade via the 10-07 bank: placement priced in medium lifetime - a serving stack spilling KV to flash is absorbable only if WRITES are budgeted in device-years of write endurance, a budget class separate from capacity. Two placement paths: deterministic, using harness-reported segment boundaries ('the harness knows whether a segment is discarded at the boundary or retained past it. A short-lived context segment has priority for HBM.'), and predictive, ridge regression over worker-segment lifetimes (Kendall's tau 0.53).
